info.title: hkfree.org diagnostics: public API of the network's measurements
info.description: What the hkfree.org diagnostics (hkdiag) measure about the network: the network map from OSPF, what network monitoring finds, the outages it measured and the outages members reported, the routers' measurement history, and the power situation from power.hkfree.org. Public, without login, readable from other sites (CORS). Nothing here identifies a member: reports come without members' addresses, and only network infrastructure is listed. Answers about the requesting device itself (/api/whoami, /api/contact, /api/signal) are not part of this API and can't be read from other sites. The app at the same origin is the human-readable version.

license.name: Data of the hkfree.org community network

get.description: Routers with their links, prefixes, internet exits, IPv6 prefixes, lost links of the last week, the extra routers the map was read from, and per AP the infrastructure devices with their monitoring health. The same snapshot the app uses (format version 1). Rebuilt at most every few seconds.

502.description: The OSPF database can't be read just now

get.summary: Outages now and in the last week
get.description: Outages members reported in the last 7 days (without their addresses), what network monitoring sees right now, the outages it measured in the last 7 days, and the power situation (APs without mains power, announced ČEZ power cuts).
Each AP device's problem as an outage with its start and end (null while it lasts), from UserDB's status read every minute. Kept for 90 days.

Speed tests members ran over hkfree.org, grouped by their AP router (with the AP's name where the member records give it): how many, the typical (median) and the lowest download, the typical upload and response time. No member addresses are kept; a group is listed only with at least min_count measurements. Kept for 180 days.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Unix time (seconds); default a week ago, at most 180 days back.

min_count.description: Groups with fewer measurements aren't listed.

get.description: Response time (median, ms) and packet loss (0 to 1) of one of the network's own addresses, as network monitoring measured them, in equal steps: 10 minutes over the last day, an hour over the last week. Only routers of the network map and the APs' own devices have a history here; any other address gets 404. Kept by this server for a few minutes.

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: The router's or AP device's IPv4 address.

parameters.name: via
parameters.description: The router before it on a path. A router that doesn't answer pings at its router ID is then measured at its address on the link from this router; without via, at another of its link addresses.

400.description: ip is not an IPv4 address

404.description: No history of this address (not the network's own), or this server keeps none

502.description: Network monitoring or the network map can't be read just now

get.description: Outages members' apps reported once their connection was back, without the members' addresses. Kept for 180 days.

Since.name: since
Since.description: Unix time (seconds); outages that ended before it are left out. Default: 7 days ago; at most 90 days back.

Network.description: See the app's engine (web/engine.js) for how a path is worked out from it.

generated_at.description: Unix time the map was built.

prefixes.description: [prefix, router, kind]: s stub, t transit, e external, a summary from a hidden part of the network.

lost_links.description: [router, router, last seen]: links of the last week that are down now.

aps.description: By UserDB AP id: the AP's infrastructure devices as [address, label, health].

enabled.description: False if this server keeps no outage reports.

sources.description: How the server's periodic reads are going: UserDB's status (what network monitoring finds) and the power monitor; null where not configured.

ap.description: The AP, where the member records name it.

read_at.description: Unix time of the last successful read.

Report.description: An outage a member's app reported. No member address.

first_bad.description: The first router on the path that didn't answer.

ap.description: AP name as UserDB's status gives it ("area - AP" when the area has several).

kind.description: 0 doesn't answer, 1 heavy packet loss, 2 packet loss, 3 slow response.
The worst seen: 0 doesn't answer, 1 heavy packet loss, 2 packet loss, 3 slow response.

measured_ip.description: The address the measurements are of: the router ID, or the router's link address when it doesn't answer pings at its router ID.

from.description: Unix time of the first point; point i is at from + i * step.

step.description: Seconds per point: 600 over a day, 3600 over a week.

rtt_ms.description: Median response time per step, null where nothing was measured. The last step is still filling.
